Package org.cyborgcats.util

Class AllianceUtil

java.lang.Object
org.cyborgcats.util.AllianceUtil
public class AllianceUtil extends Object
Utility class for alliance-aware coordinate transformations. When the active alliance is AllianceUtil.AllianceType.RED, coordinates are mirrored about the centre of the field so that game pieces and field elements can be defined once from the blue-alliance perspective.
